crownPassive.name: Guess my name
crownPassive.text: You have 3 guesses a fight. Each round, while planning, you may secretly name one enemy hero, but not the same hero two rounds running. If it planned an action, the action is cancelled and it takes 2 damage. If it planned nothing, Rumpelstiltskin takes 1 damage.

bond.name: Märchen kin
bond.text: +1 Attack for each other Märchen hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Straw into gold
actions.text: Get back one item you have already used this fight.
